title: AI providers
summary: Your keys, your model: multi-provider with a single active one, sealed keys and model switching on the fly.

blocks.text: Every account carries ITS own API keys, stored sealed (AEAD) in the api. You can connect several providers but only ONE is active: that's what reasons your turns. There is no global provider and no silent fallback to another key.

items: Open Models in the navbar and pick the provider.
Paste your full API key (it's shown only once when you create it with the provider).
Press Connect: the dapp validates live and lists available models.
The first free model (or the first in the list) becomes the active one.

blocks.title: Paste only the key
blocks.text: If it carries spaces or pasted emojis, validation rejects it: copy it again, just the key.

items: Mark the radio of the provider you want: the change is instant for the next turn.
The Model dropdown lists the active one's saved models (refreshes on open).
Changing models saves on the fly, no reconnect needed.
Each row's 🗑 disconnects that provider (deletes key and list).

blocks.text: Keys travel only over TLS, are stored encrypted, and the browser never sees your api Bearer (the dapp carries it server-side). The device never touches your keys: it only picks the active provider.
